milp.licence_note: SciPy/HiGHS are free/open-source; no paid solver used
milp.timing_note: solve_s is online MILP wall time only; excludes compilation/table construction

qubo.convention: E_Q(x)=offset + sum_{i<=j} Q[i,j] x_i x_j ; x in {0,1}; upper+diag
qubo.decision_objective_note: physical seconds require restoring C_centered via direct scorer; do not drop offset

timing.note: compile_s excludes online scan/milp; scan_s and milp_s are separate
